title: Avoid removing an AGV from an active system in the Geek application (high-risk action)
summary: When the system is active, do not remove an AGV in the Geek application. The source describes this as the worst/high-risk action and notes that access to perform it is restricted via application login (username/password). If you are not a supervisor or do not have the required credentials, do not attempt the removal action—avoid it and follow the source’s guidance to prevent the action.
when_to_use: Use this when you are working on an active system and are considering (or being asked) to remove an AGV from the Geek application.
not_for: Do not use this as a corrective recovery procedure to remove an AGV; the source does not provide a recovery sequence for when removal is requested or already attempted.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: must not perform AGV removal actions in Geek on an active system; must verify whether they have the required login access and avoid the action if they do not.
Supervisor (login holder): is the role that has the credentials/access for sensitive actions such as AGV removal (operators do not have the credentials per source).
safety_notes: The source explicitly characterizes removing an AGV from an active system as the worst/high-risk action and instructs: “Don’t remove an AGV.”
access_or_tools_needed: Geek application login/credentials (username/password) to determine whether the user has access to removal actions
Role awareness: operators vs supervisors (operators do not have credentials; supervisors do)

access_required: Geek application access (username/password) to determine whether you have credentials for removal actions
system_preconditions: System is active (source frames the risk specifically for an active system)

visual_references.description: Geek application container/AGV selection screen segment used in the source discussion of the high-risk action: “Don’t remove an AGV” and login-based access restrictions (operators lack credentials; supervisors have them).

steps.title: Do not remove an AGV from an active system in Geek
steps.purpose: Prevent the high-risk action the source describes as the worst thing a user can do on an active system.
steps.instruction: When working on an active system, do not perform the action to remove an AGV in the Geek application.
steps.expected_result: No AGV removal is performed on the active system; you avoid clicking/performing the AGV removal action in Geek.
steps.healthy_condition: You are continuing work without initiating an AGV removal action in Geek while the system is active.
steps.failure_condition: You initiate or complete an AGV removal action in Geek while the system is active.
stop_or_escalate_if: If you are about to remove an AGV from an active system, stop immediately and do not proceed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Removing an AGV from an active system is described as the worst thing a user can do; the speaker says ‘Don’t remove an AGV.’”

steps.title: Verify whether you have the required Geek credentials for AGV removal
steps.purpose: The source states Geek has username/password access control; operators do not have the credentials for sensitive actions like AGV removal.
steps.instruction: If you are asked to remove an AGV, verify whether you have the required Geek login access (username/password). The source states operators do not have the credentials; supervisors do.
steps.expected_result: You determine whether your Geek login has access to perform AGV removal actions.
steps.healthy_condition: Your login does not have the required credentials for AGV removal (consistent with the source statement that operators lack credentials).
steps.failure_condition: You proceed with AGV removal without the required credentials/access.

actions.label: Check Geek login access
actions.exact_action: Verify Geek username/password access for the removal action.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you do not have the required login access (operator credentials), stop and do not attempt the removal action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The source states the application has a username and password; operators don’t have the credentials, supervisors do.

steps.title: Do not attempt AGV removal if you are not a supervisor / lack credentials
steps.purpose: Prevent the high-risk action when the user does not have the restricted access required by the source.
steps.instruction: If you are not a supervisor or do not have the required Geek login access, do not attempt the AGV removal action. Instead, follow the source guidance to avoid the action.
steps.expected_result: No AGV removal is performed; you do not proceed with the removal action in Geek.
steps.healthy_condition: You remain in a non-removal state (no AGV removal initiated) and the request is not executed by you.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt AGV removal despite lacking the required credentials/access.

actions.label: Avoid executing removal
actions.exact_action: Do not attempt the removal action.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you are being asked to remove an AGV and you lack credentials, stop and do not attempt the action.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Operators don’t have the credentials. The supervisors do.” and “Don’t remove an AGV.”

success_criteria: No AGV removal is performed on an active system in Geek.
If removal is requested, the operator verifies credentials and does not attempt the action without required access.
healthy_conditions: Operator does not initiate AGV removal actions in Geek while the system is active.
Operator recognizes that Geek removal access is restricted by login (username/password) and that operators do not have the credentials.
failure_conditions: AGV removal is performed in Geek while the system is active.
Operator attempts AGV removal without required credentials/access.
escalation_guidance: If an AGV removal has already been attempted or is being requested, stop and escalate to the appropriate support path. The source does not provide a specific recovery procedure.
missing_details: The source does not provide a specific corrective recovery procedure for when an AGV removal has already been attempted or is requested.
The source does not provide the exact Geek UI control names/labels for the AGV removal action (only that removal exists and is access-restricted).
